source.name: Sportcal (GlobalData): Deal Focus: Atletico-Riyadh Air deal deepens Saudi's LaLiga involvement
source.quote: The long-term deal will run through the end of the 2032-33 season and will see the 70,460-capacity stadium renamed the Riyadh Air Metropolitano.
source.note: Archived copy (Wayback Machine, captured 2026-04-17) of https://www.sportcal.com/features/deal-focus-atletico-riyadh-air-deal-deepens-saudis-laliga-involvement/ — the live page 403s scripted fetchers. Both copies checked 2026-10-03 and identical. Sportcal also states the deal was unveiled in October 2024, that Civitas had been the stadium's naming-rights partner for the previous two seasons, and that Spanish reports value the Riyadh Air deal at €250m-€300m in total (€27.7m-€33.3m a year).

note: Stadium naming rights: Riyadh Air Metropolitano, announced October 2024. SportsPro (2024-10-09, https://www.sportspro.com/news/atletico-madrid-riyadh-air-stadium-naming-rights-metropolitano-laliga/) reports a nine-year deal worth a reported €250m-€300m, with the first match under the new name on 20 October 2024 against Leganes. Riyadh Air's own sponsorship page (opened via Wayback Machine, captured 2026-04-12, https://web.archive.org/web/20260412061801/https://www.riyadhair.com/en/about-us/our-story/sponsorships/atletico-de-madrid) describes the 'multi-year agreement, becoming the naming partner for one of Europe's most modern and iconic stadiums'. Sportcal also states Riyadh Air has been the front-of-shirt sponsor since August 2023 and that PIF 'wholly funds' Riyadh Air.
